description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. The Software Engineer will develop applications for manufacturing environments, write software programs, work with SQL databases, and collaborate with cross-functional and global teams on process improvements and new product introductions.
C#/.NET application engineer developing manufacturing software and SQL-backed product performance systems

Responsibilities:
• Develop applications utilizing C# and .net core programming framework for use in a manufacturing environment
• Write moderately complex software programs to operate as standalone systems or to support larger systems as subroutines
• Interface with SQL databases to store, retrieve, and manipulate data for analysis of system capability and product performance
• Work with cross-functional and global teams on process improvements and supporting new product introductions

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science
• Zero (0) years of applicable experience
• Legal authorization to work in the United States

Preferred:
• ABET-accredited engineering degree
• Experience with C#, .net framework, SQL, Python, Visual Basic
• Azure DevOps or similar tool experience
